operational_policy.queue_order: FIFO by created_at/job_id; transactional claim remains authoritative
operational_policy.resource_wait: bounded polling under the same absolute job deadline; no provider launch before admission
operational_policy.queue_timeout_state: QUEUE_TIMEOUT when queued age exceeds max_queue_wait_ms before claim
operational_policy.service_timeout_state: SERVICE_TIMEOUT is reserved for a separately instrumented service budget; this observed run records the unified JOB_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED terminal state

fifo.limitation: This is a deterministic queue-order probe, not a sustained model-service starvation SLO measurement.

retry_analysis.job_retry_policy: explicit idempotency key, maximum three attempts, durable retry_after_at
retry_analysis.note: The load artifact labels 3,109 retries; under the worker path these are repeated capacity/resource polling observations, not 3,109 durable job retries or provider relaunches.

limitations: The 25-job provider measurement predates the Phase 11 resource-wait implementation and is retained as observed evidence; the Phase 11 policy mapping does not claim a new 25-job rerun.
DEFERRED_CAPACITY and QUEUE_TIMEOUT were defined but had zero observations in this 25-job run.
